analogy.rationale: Aspartic protease inhibitors target secreted/lysosomal proteases (CTSB, CTSD, CTSL, REN) that are poorly expressed or non-essential in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; HIV protease inhibitors share the aspartic protease mechanism but act on a viral enzyme absent from these cells, while other protease classes are mechanistically distinct.
